coordinateSystem: Original body-fixed radar-model Cartesian axes; positive Z is the selected spin pole; east-positive longitude; arbitrary display phase
source: Hudson and Ostro (1994), Science 263, 940–943; Hudson, Ostro and Harris (1997), Icarus 130, 165–176; Arecibo and NASA/JPL: ecliptic J2000 lambda 253 deg, beta 56 deg, period 4.089 h; equatorial conversion uses J2000 obliquity 23.439291111 deg. The 1997 optical analysis statistically prefers the northern spin solution used here: period 4.089 h and ecliptic pole (253°, 56°). The alternative southern solution, period 4.094 h and pole (242°, 7°), was not absolutely excluded. This is the archived JPL shape, not a newly fitted model.
